title: Installments still add up
hook: Two stated cases: explore the total cash commitment behind small installments.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the total cash commitment behind small installments affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Remaining, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the total cash commitment behind small installments in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
